description.value:
Homebrew: marker effect for the Phoenix Monstrosity Form's "Shroud of Flame" aura -- automates the damage half the vanilla item's own Aura rule element never actually granted (its "effects" array was empty, so nothing happened when a creature entered or ended its turn in the aura despite the aura ring and the on/off toggle both existing already). The real ability text: "You gain an aura of fire that extends out from you. A creature that ends its turn within the aura takes 2d6 fire damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn. You can activate or deactivate this aura with a Sustain action."

Granted automatically while in Phoenix Monstrosity Form -- see Spell Effect: Monstrosity Form's own GrantItem rule element (predicate: monstrosity-form:phoenix). Not meant to be dragged onto a sheet manually. Presence of this effect is what scripts/shroud-of-flame.js checks for, alongside the existing "shrouded" toggle (the vanilla on/off RollOption -- still the correct way to turn the aura on and off; this effect only tracks "is a Phoenix," not "is the aura currently on"), before rolling damage against a creature that ends its turn within 20 feet at the end of each combatant's turn.

Only the turn-end trigger is automated -- "enters the aura" (a movement-triggered case) is not, since reliably detecting a token's path crossing the aura ring mid-movement is a materially harder problem than a simple turn-based check.
